_comment: 301 redirects from old WordPress URLs (root-level, e.g. futurenestproperty.in/some-slug/) to new URLs (futurenestproperty.in/blog/some-slug). 'permanent: true' sends a 301 — this is what tells Google to transfer ranking signals to the new URL. When you paste the full list of ~30 old URLs, Claude will fill in every entry below.
